mapper.insert: INSERT into ${database.prefix.userms}hou_base_modularizationd ( page_data, page_type, create_time, page_is_index, page_start ) VALUES ( #{param.pageData}, #{param.pageType}, now(), #{param.pageIsIndex}, #{param.pageStart})

INSERT into ${database.prefix.userms}hou_base_modularizationd ( page_id, shop_id, page_name, page_data, page_type, create_time, page_is_index, goodsAllIdJson, page_start ) VALUES (#{param.pageId},#{param.shopId},#{param.pageName},#{param.pageData},#{param.pageType},now(),#{param.pageIsIndex},#{param.goodsAllIdJson},#{param.pageStart})
mapper.update: UPDATE ${database.prefix.userms}hou_base_modularizationd SET page_data =#{param.pageData} , page_type =#{param.pageType} , create_time =now() where page_id = #{param.pageId}
mapper.select: SELECT gc.common_is_xian FROM ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb ON gc.shop_id = sb.supplier_shop_id WHERE gc.common_state = 1 AND gc.common_verify = 1 AND NOW( ) > gc.common_sell_time AND sb.shop_status = 3 AND gc.goods_id = #{goodsId} LIMIT 1

select page_id,page_name,page_data,page_type,page_start,page_default,page_cover_url,create_time from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_base_modularizationd where page_default = 1 and page_id = #{param.pageId}
